written: 2026-10-22, before any change to the encoder's copy of a sentence for work terms. Builder-written sentences, used once to judge the change. Targets use a work term the encoder misread in a probe with one fixed frame ('I do X for a small shop.': bookkeeping, 'the books', IT, cybersecurity); here each term appears in other wording. A target hits when any expected activity is among the sentence's five suggestions. Controls use the same words in other senses (reading books, lower-case 'it', capitals, security guards); their five suggestions must be identical before and after the change. n11 is a known hard case (a bookshop section) and is reported, not excused.
pass_rule: Ship only if target hits rise, at least 14 of 18 targets hit, every control except n11 keeps identical suggestions, and the existing A1-A3, A6, fairness, ownership, held-out and B7 results are not lower.
